relations.subject: John Myrdhin Reynolds
relations.evidence: I began working on the translation of Bonpo Dzogchen texts first with Geshe Tenzin Wangyal in Italy some years ago

relations.subject: John Myrdhin Reynolds
relations.evidence: and continued doing this with Lopon Tenzin Namdak on his three visits to the West.

relations.subject: John Myrdhin Reynolds
relations.evidence: As a consequence of this work, I organized the Bonpo Translation Project in order to make translations of Bonpo texts

relations.subject: John Myrdhin Reynolds
relations.evidence: my interest in the Bon tradition was stimulated by Namkhai Norbu Rinpoche, head of the Dzogchen Community.
